export.Du {start} au {end} inclus. {meals} repa: From {start} through {end}, inclusive. {meals} meals; {foods} food records.
By day: summary. By meal: totals. Foods: filterable details. Water: recorded volumes.
export.Masse = main_food.quantity × serving_amo: Mass = main_food.quantity × serving_amount × parent dish multipliers, following the application’s nutrition calculation.
export.Nombre d’unités = masse calculée / g_per: Number of units = calculated mass / g_per_unit. Foodvisor uses this equivalent mass for nutrients, including liquids.
export.Valeurs Foodvisor converties en grammes: Foodvisor values converted to grams: protein /4, carbohydrates /4, fat /9, fiber /2, then scaled to consumed mass.
export.Chaque composante main_food est comptée: Each main_food component is counted once, then its subfoods. The In dish column shows relationships.
export.Cellule vide = valeur absente. Un total: Blank cell = missing value. A total is blank if any component is unknown; missing values are not treated as zero.
export.L’onglet Eau affiche uniquement les volu: The Water sheet shows recorded volumes only. A blank cell does not mean zero consumption.
export.Affichage à deux décimales ; les totaux: Displayed to two decimal places; totals are calculated before rounding. No visual comparison was made with totals shown in the application.
export.JSON fusionné Foodvisor conservé séparém: Merged Foodvisor JSON is kept separately for raw fields and details not shown here.
